facts.fact: 海伦娜坐在布莱尔家女性世代相传的樱桃木桌旁。
facts.anchor: Helena sat at the cherry wood table passed down to the Blair women

facts.fact: 罗温姑妈把一杯热蒲公英茶放到海伦娜面前，想冲开堵塞她能力的东西。
facts.anchor: Aunt Rowan placed a steaming cup of dandelion tea in front of Helena

facts.fact: 埃莉说海伦娜的气场有些雾蒙蒙的。
facts.anchor: Your aura is a little foggy

facts.fact: 海伦娜仍能操控自己的元素（水），但唯独读不到辛西娅的念头。
facts.anchor: I can still control my element

facts.fact: 海伦娜承认自己讨厌辛西娅，理由之一是辛西娅把克莱奥从她们身边带走。
facts.anchor: She has taken Clio away from us

facts.fact: 埃莉主动替海伦娜上明天的班，好让她陪拉克兰叔叔去问话。
facts.anchor: she had volunteered to cover Helena’s shift on the morrow

facts.fact: 辛西娅把旧裙匆匆染黑，为丈夫服丧。
facts.anchor: Cynthia couldn’t stop rubbing the uneven streaks of black staining her skirt

facts.fact: 海伦娜在问话中向辛西娅承认自己能读心。
